history.summary: A 1,012 sqft 999-year 3BR at Jansen House, a 21-unit boutique new launch (TOP ~2027) in D19 Serangoon/Kovan at $2.038M ($2,014 PSF). Near-freehold tenure in a landed enclave is the pitch, but it's a tiny single-block development 1.35km from MRT at full new-launch PSF.
history.rating_rationale: Jansen House is a single 5-storey, 21-unit boutique block — inherently illiquid on exit — at $2,014 PSF (the URA 'median' of $2,050 is essentially this project's own new-launch transactions, 19 txns, bias flagged, so no independent price anchor). It is 1.35km (16-min walk) from Kovan MRT, i.e. effectively car-dependent, and minimal facilities. 999-yr tenure is nice but doesn't offset a thin-data micro-development bought at peak PSF with a shallow resale pool. score_1000 just 460. This is the boutique-illiquidity profile to avoid for investment.
red_flags: 21-unit single-block boutique — very shallow resale liquidity
$2,014 PSF is full new-launch pricing; URA median is the project itself (bias flagged)
Minimal facilities; investor-rental-focused unit mix dilutes scarcity
TOP ~2027 — capital locked with developer/progress risk
catalysts: 999-year leasehold in a freehold landed enclave
NEX mall and Serangoon/Kovan amenities nearby
Macly boutique product appeals to landed right-sizers

agent_evaluation.rental_assessment: Designed as a rental play, but a 3BR 1.35km from MRT in a 21-unit block competes weakly for tenants against transit-adjacent stock; yield ~2.5-3% on a $2.04M base.
agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Entering at peak new-launch PSF in a micro-development with no resale track record and poor connectivity leaves little appreciation headroom once the launch premium normalizes.
